# `images` — Image feature pipeline: CLI reference

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Rendered from the spec registry
> (`geneva_examples/examples/images/__init__.py`) by `geneva_examples/docs_gen/`;
> regenerate with `make docs`. The same text is shown by `uv run <command> --help`.
> Docs index: [`docs/README.md`](../../README.md).

Load images from Hugging Face, then enrich them with Geneva UDF backfills: cheap CPU metadata, OpenCLIP embeddings, and BLIP captions.

Start with **Ingest images**, then run any feature step.

**Modality:** `image` · **Steps in pipeline order:** [`ingest-images`](#ingest-images) → [`lightweight`](#lightweight) → [`embed`](#embed) → [`caption`](#caption)

## Common options (every command)

Every command below is generated by `geneva_examples/core/spec.py` (`build_command`) and accepts these options in addition to its own:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | `None` | Path to config.yaml (default ./config.yaml). |
| `--mode` | choice: local \| enterprise | `None` | Connection mode: 'local' or 'enterprise'. |
| `--db-uri` | str | `None` | Override the config db_uri (enterprise mode). |
| `--log-level` | str | `INFO` | Logging level. |

A `None` default is resolved at runtime: `--mode` and `--db-uri` follow the config-file precedence, and some model steps resolve `--num-gpus None` to a per-step GPU fraction inside their `run()` (see the step's source file).

## `ingest-images`

**Ingest images**

Create the table and stream images from a Hugging Face dataset into an `image` (bytes) + `image_id`/`label` schema, ready for the feature steps.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run ingest-images [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | none |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/images/ingest.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/images/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `images` | Target table name. |
| `--num-images` | int ≥ 1 | `75` | Number of images to load. |
| `--frag-size` | int ≥ 1 | `25` | Images per record batch. |
| `--hf-dataset` | str | `timm/oxford-iiit-pet` | Hugging Face dataset name. |
| `--hf-split` | str | `train` | Hugging Face dataset split. |
| `--overwrite` / `--no-overwrite` | flag | `--overwrite` | Drop the table first if it exists. |
| `--table-write-retries` | int ≥ 0 | `5` | Retries for create/add ops. |
| `--table-write-retry-sleep-s` | float ≥ 0 | `2.0` | Base sleep (s) between table-write retries. |

## `lightweight`

**File size + dimensions**

Backfill two cheap CPU columns — `file_size` (byte length) and `dimensions` (width/height) — a fast smoke test of the backfill path.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run lightweight [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | no (CPU-only) |
| Prerequisite | run ingest-images first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/images/lightweight.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/images/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `images` | Target table name. |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int ≥ 1 | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (min). |
| `--backfill-concurrency` | int ≥ 1 | `32` | Backfill concurrency. |
| `--backfill-task-size` | int ≥ 1 | `256` | Backfill task size. |
| `--backfill-checkpoint-size` | int ≥ 1 | `128` | Backfill checkpoint size. |
| `--backfill-flush-interval-s` | float ≥ 0 | `30.0` | Batch checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--use-cpu-only-pool` / `--no-use-cpu-only-pool` | flag | `--use-cpu-only-pool` | Keep this CPU-only step off the GPU nodes (enterprise). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int ≥ 1 | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int ≥ 0 | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |

## `embed`

**OpenCLIP embeddings**

Backfill an `embedding` column with OpenCLIP ViT-B-32, then (optionally) run a local text→image search demo. Runs on GPU in enterprise mode, CPU locally.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run embed [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | yes — runs a model (CPU-only in local mode) |
| Prerequisite | run ingest-images first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/images/embed.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/images/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `images` | Target table name. |
| `--query-text` | str | `a golden retriever` | Text query for the search demo. |
| `--batch-size` | int ≥ 1 | `1024` | DataLoader batch size (auto-shrunk locally). |
| `--num-workers` | int ≥ 0 | `8` | DataLoader worker processes (0 locally). |
| `--num-cpus` | float ≥ 0.0 | `8.0` | CPUs per model task (capped locally). |
| `--num-gpus` | float | `None` | GPUs per task (forced to 0 locally). |
| `--memory-gib` | int ≥ 1 | `1` | Memory (GiB) per task (geneva caps <2). |
| `--checkpoint-size` | int ≥ 1 | `1024` | Rows per UDF __call__. |
| `--task-size` | int ≥ 1 | `1024` | Rows per read task. |
| `--concurrency` | int ≥ 1 | `8` | Backfill concurrency (1 locally). |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int ≥ 1 | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (min). |
| `--flush-interval-s` | float ≥ 0 | `30.0` | Checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int ≥ 1 | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int ≥ 0 | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |
| `--search-demo` / `--no-search-demo` | flag | `--search-demo` | Run the local text→image search demo after. |
